post.text:
The cat climbed a tree in the yard but couldn’t get back down, staying stuck there for quite a while and crying out to its owner. 🥺

Hearing the cries, the man quickly placed a ladder against the tree and climbed up.

As they made their way down together, the cat clung tightly https://t.co/rwRfBRKkaa
post.author_description: Everything about cats 😺 all cat lovers, stay tuned! 😘❤️

description.description: A humorous clip showing a person attempting to climb down a wooden ladder while a striped tabby cat is tightly clinging to their leg. In the first frame, the person is high up near a tree's trunk. In the second frame, as the person steps down a rung, the cat hangs on with its claws. In the final frame, the person is lower on the ladder, but the cat remains firmly attached to their calf as they descend.
